tldr: Mars through the 6th house brings focus to work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance.
body: Mars transiting the 6th house energizes work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports daily systems and practical support: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or overwork or neglecting the body.
advice: Aim the fire in the 6th house deliberately. Work with work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
